verdict.rationale: The evidence documents backends for NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA), AMD (HIP), Moore Threads (MUSA), Apple silicon (Metal/Accelerate) and x86 SIMD/AMX. Nothing in the pack mentions TPUs, Gaudi, or a plugin mechanism for adding specialized accelerators. A community remark that the project 'wants to support any computation device' is general and does not show this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
